body: Chief: contingency shape APPROVED as written, INCLUDING the LocalBaseline snapshot-before-vectorFor — the provenance hole is the same invariant, deferring it would leave a call-free Withheld history reachable. Confirmed points: AttemptReceipt.of validates every EmbeddingReceipt.isKeyConsistent and providerCalls == embeddingReceipts.map(_.call) exactly (so the nested call checksums are the commitment — no rendering version bump needed); a private owned-key snapshot is the digest authority (Plain | Keyed(snapshot) | Withheld(missing)) reused by addResultDecisions; failClosed constructs empty provenance and of refuses missing-key Withheld with any call provenance; static clones at capture and read; the mutable-alias adversarial test. Add the public-item rule decision: in a keyless mixed batch, deny non-public items and let public items proceed ONLY if the receipt can represent the partial denial honestly; otherwise deny all — pick one, state it in the ADR D6 paragraph, test it. Handoff stands at 00:05Z unless m1 claims first; on your SHA the reviewer re-runs the six probes and I run the 3-platform archive gate.
